underlines.text: He came, and in such very good time, that the ladies were none of them dressed.

reference.text: Yes, he had no engagement at all for to-morrow; and her invitation was accepted with alacrity.

underlines.text: The same anxiety to get them by themselves was visible again in the evening.

reference.text: In ran Mrs. Bennet to her daughters’ room, in her dressing-gown, and with her hair half finished, crying out,—
